name: Cost to decide on rule changes

question.question: How expensive is it to participate as a peer in a governance decision by the governing body?
question.instruction: Evaluate this criteria for each decision making body from https://www.w3.org/TR/did-rubric#criteria-37.

possibleResponses.label: E
possibleResponses.meaning: Not possible to participate because the rules are immutable

relevance: Governance takes resources, which can limit the ability of interested parties to influence rulemaking. Generally, the more expensive it is to participate, the more governance centralizes to those parties most able to make the investment.

exampleAssessments.note: The most common way to be involved is by invitation from Digital Bazaar, either as an employee, subcontractor, or advisor. (D)
The largest cost is time to participate and a track record for credibility. (B)
Foundation leadership is initially selected by Digital Bazaar and self-selecting thereafter. (D)
